blurb: Guests arrive before sunrise, meet the flight team, and travel to the launch site. They enjoy a balloon flight of approximately one hour, followed by a balloon pack up experience and a celebration breakfast at a local restaurant. Flights depart from several locations including Byron Bay, Camden, Mudgee, Hunter Valley, and Burketown.
